text: 应朝鲜劳动党中央委员会和朝鲜民主主义人民共和国政府邀请，中共中央政治局常委、全国政协主席王沪宁于7月15日至17日率中国党政代表团对朝鲜进行正式友好访问，在平壤会见朝鲜劳动党总书记、国务委员长金正恩，同朝鲜劳动党中央政治局常委、国务委员会副委员长、内阁总理朴泰成共同出席《中朝友好合作互助条约》签订65周年纪念招待会，同朝鲜劳动党中央政治局常委、中央书记、组织指导部部长赵甬元举行会谈。(新华社)
text_en: At the invitation of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and the Government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Wang Huning, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, led a Chinese Party and government delegation on an official goodwill visit to the DPRK from July 15 to 17. He met with Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs Commission, in Pyongyang; jointly attended a reception commemorating the 65th anniversary of the signing of the China-DPRK Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance with Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, Vice President of the State Affairs Commission, and Premier of the Cabinet; and held talks with Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, Secretary of the Central Committee, and Director of the Organization and Guidance Department. (Xinhua)
